name: flux
description: Bounded local access to Flux notes, working list, and queued video digest.
long_description: Use Flux through seven bounded MCP tools that list, read, and create local notes, fetch complete native YouTube captions, read or replace the current working list, and read the one current video digest request. The bundle cannot watch videos and does not expose arbitrary files, deletion, shell commands, cloud sync, messages, agent routing, or secrets.

tools.name: flux_list_notes
tools.description: List Flux note metadata with optional folder and source filters.

tools.name: flux_read_note
tools.description: Read one complete Markdown note by stable identifier and folder.

tools.name: flux_create_note
tools.description: Save user-provided text as a local Markdown note.

tools.name: flux_fetch_youtube_transcript
tools.description: Fetch native YouTube captions and save the complete transcript locally.

tools.name: flux_read_working_list
tools.description: Read the current Flux working list.

tools.name: flux_read_video_digest_request
tools.description: Read the current YouTube URL queued for an agent video digest.

tools.name: flux_save_working_list
tools.description: Replace the current Flux working list with an explicit title and items.
